qualifications: The sources are mostly podcast syntheses and practical education examples, so they establish a recurring wiki pattern rather than one universal pedagogy.
claims.statement: Learning sources treat durable skill as active work: [[SelfTestingMemoryPractice]], [[DesirableDifficulty]], [[SelfDirectedLearning]], and [[LearningExperienceDesign]] preserve recall, reasoning, curiosity, and correction rather than treating fluent answers as enough.

qualifications: The specific risks differ across coding, education, enterprise deployment, markets, robotics, creator work, and physical retail, so the claim should stay at the implementation-pattern level.
claims.statement: AI and product/work sources repeatedly show that capability becomes useful only when embedded in [[HumanJudgmentUnderAI]], [[AIEngineeringThinking]], [[AICodingVerification]], workflows, distribution, and customer or classroom context.

qualifications: Some examples are drama-mediated, advice-show, or source-scoped workplace commentary rather than formal labor-law or clinical guidance.
claims.statement: Workplace sources frame career outcomes around boundaries, evidence, communication, pacing, and institutional roles through [[WorkplaceBullying]], [[PsychologicalBoundaryProtection]], [[BankDueDiligence]], [[BankInternalAudit]], and [[WorkplaceRelationshipBoundaries]].

qualifications: Individual attitude and routine design cannot substitute for health, money, housing, care access, disability support, or local infrastructure.
claims.statement: Society and aging sources present capability as social and environmental: [[SuccessfulAging]], [[CognitiveAging]], [[CognitiveResilience]], and [[SustainableHealthOptimization]] depend on connection, balance, routines, service access, and adaptive health practices.

qualifications: The late-Han cases are historical analogies, not direct prescriptions for modern education or workplace institutions.
claims.statement: Historical and modern institution sources show education, reputation, and office channels as double-edged: [[Taixue]], [[OfficialSelectionChannelCompetition]], [[EmptyReputationRealityGap]], and [[CourtFeedbackCollapse]] can build public capacity or expose capable people to capture and retaliation.

qualifications: The pacing examples span health Q&A, finance-worker consumption, and workplace commentary, so the synthesis should not collapse them into a single productivity rule.
claims.statement: Several sources frame sustainable performance as pacing under constraints: [[SustainableHealthOptimization]], [[MiddleClassConsumptionPressure]], [[LifestyleCostRationalization]], and bounded workplace use of [[DeepSeek]] distinguish recovery or adaptation from avoidance.

summary: Work, education, and society sources converge on a practical pattern: durable capability comes from bounded institutions, active learning, realistic workplace judgment, and human feedback loops. AI and other tools can compress work, but the useful sources keep returning to self-directed effort, context, verification, social trust, pacing, health, and environments that let people act under real constraints.
